trajectory_summary: The call opens cooperative, dips slightly on a name-correction friction point, warms again through Verify, then stalls for several minutes on bill/kWh retrieval before ending on a soft, unconfirmed booking. Energy never really builds toward urgency — the rep never flips the high bill or the customer's stated interest into a forward pull, and the close is procedurally weak (no locked time, no button-up).
outcome_dispute: This should be read as tentative/no_appointment rather than a clean booked outcome — no date or time was ever stated, only a vague 'we'll set up a meeting' and a promise from the customer to email a bill later.
